import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import textfile as m
        import tempfile
        from pathlib import Path
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = Path(d) / 'in.txt'
            for raw, expected in [(b'\xef\xbb\xbfhello', 'hello'), ('雪'.encode(), '雪'), (b'', '')]:
                p.write_bytes(raw)
                self.assertEqual(m.read(p), expected)
